text:
mia: Quick eyes please — PR #5234 is blocked on CI. Release merge window today at 16:00 PT. shard-7 keeps failing on `TestKVEvictIntegration::kv_eviction_respects_timeouts`. Locally green.

raj: Saw it earlier. Stacktrace looks like a ~2m hang in the kv loop, probably infra noise. Reproducer attached: https://ci.redwood/invest/5234-shard7.

lee: Can we do a targeted rerun for shard-7? That usually clears transient infra flakes.

ci-bot: buildkite — job shard-7 failed: exit_code=1
```
=== FAIL: TestKVEvictIntegration (2.03s)
fatal error: test timed out waiting for eviction
goroutine 1234 [running]:
...
```

sara: If rerun passes we can merge, but policy needs one reviewer approval to bypass the queue for the release branch. @danny are you able to approve after the rerun?

danny: I'm OOO until 15:30 PT. If the rerun is green I'll approve before the merge window. If it flakes again, please ping oncall.

mia: I'll trigger a targeted rerun now and hold merge until we see results. If it keeps failing I'll add a `quarantine:shard7` label and escalate. Tagging `release-hotfix` for priority.

oncall-bot: @mia requested targeted rerun for PR 5234 on shard-7 — triggered.

ci-bot: targeted rerun started (shard-7) — attempt 1

ci-bot: targeted rerun result — shard-7: PASSED ✅ (0 flaky tests)

sara: Nice, LGTM. approving now :thumbsup: 

danny: Approved. Merge queued. Monitor canary.

mia: Thanks all — I’ll watch post-merge canary and revert if we see regression. Labeling thread: `merge-window`, `rerun-success`.
